#teamStrip .ct{min-width:16px;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000,0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#teamStrip .pips{display:flex;gap:3px;position:absolute;top:26px}
#teamStrip .a .pips{right:0}
#teamStrip .e .pips{left:0}
#teamStrip .pips i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid currentColor;opacity:.5}
#teamStrip .pips i.on{background:currentColor;opacity:1}
#mePanel{position:absolute;left:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-left));top:10px;width:150px;padding:5px 8px 6px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--glass,rgba(12,16,26,.7));border:1px solid var(--hair,rgba(255,255,255,.16));box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,224,138,.55);display:none}
body.tf #mePanel{display:block}
body.tf.touch #mePanel{top:8px}
#mePanel .mh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:12px;margin-bottom:4px;font:800 9px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#ffe08a}
#mePanel .mh .sp{flex:1}
#mePanel .mc{display:flex;gap:2px}
#mePanel .mc i{width:9px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
#mePanel .mc i.on{background:#ffe08a}
#mePanel .mc.full i{background:#fff}
#mePanel .mb{position:relative;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(8,10,16,.7);overflow:hidden;margin-top:3px}
#mePanel .mb i{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(1);background:#ffe08a}
#mePanel .mb.arm{height:4px}
#mePanel .mb.arm i{background:#b9c4d6}
#mePanel .mb.burst{height:3px}
#mePanel .mb.burst i{background:#fff;opacity:.85;transform:scaleX(0)}
#mePanel .st{display:none;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:var(--c,#fff);font:700 8px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em}
#mePanel .st.on{display:inline-flex}
#mePanel .st i{width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--c,#fff);transform:rotate(45deg) scale(.85)}
#lineup{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:80;display:none;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;padding:10px 14px 9px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--glass-strong,rgba(12,16,26,.9));border:1px solid var(--hair,rgba(255,255,255,.2));font:700 10px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#e8edf6;white-space:nowrap}
#lineup.on{display:block}
#lineup .cols{display:flex;gap:18px}
#lineup .col{min-width:210px}
#lineup h4{margin:0 0 5px;font:800 10px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.22em}
#lineup .col.a h4{color:var(--tm)}
#lineup .col.e h4{color:var(--tf)}
#lineup .r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:2px 0 2px 6px;border-left:3px solid currentColor}
#lineup .col.a .r{color:var(--tm)}
#lineup .col.e .r{color:var(--tf)}
#lineup .r span{color:#fff;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:104px}
#lineup .r em{font-style:normal;color:#aab4c6;font-size:9px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:150px}
#lineup small{display:block;margin-top:6px;text-align:center;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#8e99ad}
body.tf #toast{top:88px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em}
body.tf #big{top:16%;font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,64px)}
body.tf #sub{top:calc(16% + clamp(34px,6.5vw,66px));font-size:11px}
body.tf #banner{display:none}
body.tf #wxchip{top:66px;white-space:nowrap}
body.tf #wxcard{top:88px;padding:5px 10px 5px 8px;max-width:min(80vw,260px)}
body.tf #wxcard span{display:none}
body.tf #wxturn{top:88px;padding:4px 14px;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
body.tf #radar{left:auto;right:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-right));top:8px;width:112px;height:112px}
body.touch.tf #radar{width:84px;height:84px}
body.tf #arrows i{margin:-7px 0 0 -7px;border-left-width:14px;border-top-width:7px;border-bottom-width:7px}
body.tf #menuBtn{left:auto;right:calc(8px + 112px + 10px + env(safe-area-inset-right));top:10px}
body.touch.tf #menuBtn{right:calc(8px + 84px + 8px + env(safe-area-inset-right));top:8px;width:40px;height:40px}
@media (max-height:520px){body.tf #toast{top:70px;font-size:12px}body.tf #wxchip{top:50px}body.tf #wxcard,body.tf #wxturn{top:70px}}
